nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Học hành & dự định · bài tự soạn
L: Hey Ben, your English sounds way better these days.
Thanks! I've been watching shows with English subtitles.
Seriously? Doesn't that get boring after a while?
Not really. I pick shows I'm into, so it doesn't feel like studying.
Smart. Do you write down new words?
Yeah, a few every night. Then I try to use them the next day.
I wish I had your patience. I always give up after a week.
Don't be so hard on yourself. Just start small, like ten minutes a day.
Ten minutes? I could manage that, I guess.
See? Piece of cake. Wanna watch an episode together tonight?

exq.q: What is Ben doing to improve his English?
exq.why: “watching shows with English subtitles” = xem phim có phụ đề tiếng Anh.

exq.q: Why does studying not feel boring to Ben?
exq.why: “I pick shows I'm into” = chọn phim mình mê.

exq.q: How long does Ben suggest Anna should study each day?
exq.why: “like ten minutes a day” = khoảng mười phút mỗi ngày.

exq.q: What do they plan to do tonight?
exq.why: “Wanna watch an episode together tonight?” → “Count me in!”
